title: HABS / HAER / HALS

title: Chronicling America

title: OSTI.GOV

title: Smithsonian Open Access

title: Sanborn Maps Collection

title: National Archives Catalog
recovery_instruction: NARA explains archival descriptions and digital objects; a catalog entry is not necessarily the underlying scanned record.

title: International Ice Patrol Annual Reports
recovery_instruction: USCG annual reports index is independently discoverable, including historic decade ZIPs; select the year before claiming any PDF read.

title: Congressional Research Service Products
recovery_instruction: Congress.gov CRS product portal restricted in this research client. Preserve report number/date; no specific report retrieved.

title: Federal Audit Clearinghouse
recovery_instruction: GSA FAC instructions distinguish October 2023 new-platform submissions from historic Census data; check filing era.

title: RECAP Archive / CourtListener
recovery_instruction: RECAP's provider-run search is independently indexed. An absent RECAP hit cannot establish that a case filing never existed in PACER.

title: National Hurricane Center Data Archive
recovery_instruction: NHC identifies tropical cyclone reports, archived advisories and later best-track data as distinct record types.

title: Manual of Surveying Instructions — 2009
recovery_instruction: BLM identifies the large 2009 surveying manual and its errata; a client size ceiling is not document disappearance.

title: U.S. Coast Guard Light List
recovery_instruction: USCG publishes annual Light List volumes and weekly corrections; record edition and correction week.

title: NOAA Historical Hurricane Tracks
recovery_instruction: NOAA map and underlying dataset description were independently indexed; use a named storm, basin and version.

title: Railroad Maps, 1828–1900
recovery_instruction: LOC warns collection maps include promotional routes never constructed; verify target date and operating status.

title: Digital Public Library of America
recovery_instruction: DPLA page not independently confirmed through an authoritative production URL here; follow to the contributing holding institution.

title: Veterans History Project Collection
recovery_instruction: LOC notes that not every donated veterans-history collection includes a digitized recording or letter. Check item availability.

title: Biodiversity Heritage Library
recovery_instruction: The BHL provider search portal was independently indexed; verify volume, page, edition and item rights.
